# Mushi Mushi

> Every bug in one queue — user reports, Sentry errors, Slack, coding agents. Plain-English diagnosis + a ready fix, in your editor. Open source.

Canonical docs: https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs
Product home: https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi
GitHub: https://github.com/kensaurus/mushi-mushi
npm org: https://www.npmjs.com/org/mushi-mushi

## Start here (MCP-first)

- [Sample diagnosis](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/demo/diagnosis): A sample Mushi Mushi diagnosis you can read without signing up. A user's complaint, what the widget captured, the plain-English cause and the fix prompt.
- [Incident loop](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/quickstart/incident-loop): Run npx mushi-mushi, ship, and let Mushi Mushi turn your first user-reported bug into a plain-English diagnosis and a paste-ready fix for Cursor or Claude Code.
- [Lovable or Bolt (no terminal)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/quickstart/lovable-bolt): Add Mushi Mushi to a Lovable or Bolt app without a terminal. Paste one script tag through your prompt, then read each bug's plain-English cause and fix prompt.
- [MCP server](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/quickstart/mcp): Set up the Mushi Mushi MCP server with npx mushi-mushi setup. Read bug reports, get fix context, and dispatch fixes from Cursor, Claude Code or any MCP client.
- [Ask Lovable why it broke](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/quickstart/lovable-mcp): Add Mushi Mushi to Lovable as an MCP connector in three steps; Lovable reads the plain-English diagnosis and fixes the bug. Claude Code and Cursor in one paste.
- [Connect your AI client](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/connect): One-click MCP setup for Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, Claude and Zed, with a keyless demo.
- [Choose your stack](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/quickstart): Install Mushi Mushi with npx mushi-mushi, connect Cursor or Claude Code over MCP, and turn user bug reports into plain-English diagnoses with ready fixes.
- [Pricing](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/pricing): Mushi Mushi pricing. Free for one app and 100 AI bug diagnoses a month. Builder $29/mo for 3 apps, Studio $79/mo for 10. Free to self-host.
- [Compare Mushi with Sentry, Jam and PostHog](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/compare): Honest, dated comparisons of Mushi Mushi with Sentry, Jam and PostHog, plus Sentry alternatives for solo founders. Every number links to its source.

## SDK quickstarts

- [React](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/quickstart/react): Add the Mushi Mushi React SDK in one command. npx mushi-mushi installs the bug-report widget, writes env vars, and offers to send a test report.
- [Web / vanilla JS](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/quickstart/web): Add the Mushi Mushi browser SDK to any site without a framework. Install @mushi-mushi/web, call Mushi.init, and file reports from your buttons or the widget.
- [React Native](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/quickstart/react-native): Add Mushi Mushi shake-to-report to a React Native or Expo app with @mushi-mushi/react-native. Install, mount the provider, and check the first report.

## SDK reference

- [SDK index](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks): Bug-reporting SDKs for React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, React Native, Capacitor and Node, installed by npx mushi-mushi, plus preview iOS, Android and Flutter SDKs.
- [Project ID & API keys](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/credentials): Where to find your Mushi Mushi project ID and API key, what the report:write and mcp scopes allow, the one mushi_ key format, and env var names per framework.
- [@mushi-mushi/web](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/web): Reference for @mushi-mushi/web, the Mushi Mushi browser SDK. Screenshots, console and network capture, the Shadow DOM widget, sampling, beforeSend and privacy.
- [@mushi-mushi/react](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/react): Reference for @mushi-mushi/react, Mushi Mushi for React. MushiProvider, useMushi, useMushiSdk and useMushiReport hooks, user identity, rewards hooks and badge.
- [@mushi-mushi/node](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/node): Send Node server errors to Mushi Mushi with @mushi-mushi/node. Express, Fastify and Hono handlers tag each report with request method, URL and trace context.
- [@mushi-mushi/cli](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/cli): Reference for @mushi-mushi/cli, the Mushi Mushi CLI. Log in, connect a project, run doctor, list reports, dispatch agent fixes and merge their pull requests.
- [@mushi-mushi/mcp](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/mcp): Reference for @mushi-mushi/mcp, the Mushi Mushi MCP server for Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code and Windsurf. stdio and hosted HTTP transports, scopes and setup.
- [MCP tools reference](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/mcp-tools): Every tool, resource and prompt the Mushi MCP server exposes to Cursor, Claude Code and other editors, with its read or write scope, from the catalog.

## All pages

- [Mushi Mushi — know why your AI-built app broke, with the fix ready](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs): Your AI shipped it. Mushi tells you why it broke: a plain-English diagnosis and a ready fix in your editor. Open source, Sentry optional.
- [Mushi Mushi admin console](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin): Guide to the Mushi Mushi admin console. The Bugs list, fix drafts and pull requests, plain-English questions about your bug data, and links to every page.
- [User activity](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/activity): The User activity view on Home in the Mushi Mushi console shows an app's end-user sessions, top pages, and signed-in vs anonymous users over the last 30 days.
- [Unusual spikes](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/anomalies): The Unusual spikes view in the Mushi Mushi console runs statistical detectors on your metrics and files a bug report when a spike starts right after a release.
- [Spam & abuse](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/anti-gaming): The Spam & abuse page in Mushi Mushi lists devices that send reports and flags any that look like one person with many accounts or a report flood, for review.
- [Audit log](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/audit): The Audit log in the Mushi Mushi console records admin actions and key events, like who minted or revoked an API key, changed settings or merged a pull request.
- [Billing](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/billing): The Billing view shows your Mushi Mushi plan, diagnosis quota, usage alerts at 50% and 80%, your projected bill and your spend cap.
- [Checks](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/checks): The Checks page in the Mushi Mushi console shows every automatic check on this app with its state, when it last ran and its open count, failing checks first.
- [CI runners](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/ci): The CI runners page in the Mushi Mushi console shows where tests run, how long they wait for a machine, and whether a red check was your code or the machine.
- [CLI device auth](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/cli-auth): The Mushi Mushi console page that mushi login opens so you can approve a CLI device code while signed in, and how the device authorization flow works.
- [Code size](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/code-health): The Code size view in the Mushi Mushi console charts bundle size and oversized files from your CI over time, so you see an app getting heavier before users do.
- [Compliance](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/compliance): The Compliance view in the Mushi Mushi console has SOC 2 control evidence, retention policies, data subject requests and residency, and prints an evidence PDF.
- [Connect](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/connect): The Connect page wires GitHub, the SDK, MCP, the CLI and your editor to a Mushi Mushi project, and shows when your installed SDK is out of date.
- [Content checks](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/content): The Content checks page in the Mushi Mushi console queues low-scoring or flagged AI-generated copy, release notes and knowledge snippets so you can fix them.
- [AI spend](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/cost): The AI spend view in the Mushi Mushi console shows LLM token use and estimated spend per model and step for a project, so you can see what each diagnosis costs.
- [Spend credits](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/credits): Spend credits lists expiring Cursor and Firecrawl credits and every way Mushi Mushi can spend them fixing bugs, improving apps with skills and checking sites.
- [Home](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/dashboard): Home in the Mushi Mushi console shows how one app is doing: is it up, what needs you, what is shipping, which pages have bugs and who can reach it.
- [Design system](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/design): The Design system page in Mushi Mushi shows tokens, contrast pairs, type scale and a deviance score for off-token code. Token and rule edits open a draft PR.
- [Docs bridge](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/docs-bridge): The docs bridge is the Mushi Mushi console's sign-in relay that lets the docs site sync your migration checklist progress, after you click Allow.
- [Schema changes](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/drift): The Schema changes view in Mushi Mushi compares API routes, app map and database tables with the last scan, showing what changed and what may break a caller.
- [Experiments](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/experiments): The Experiments page in the Mushi Mushi console defines and runs A/B tests on your app and analyses them with CUPED variance reduction and sequential testing.
- [Code map](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/explore): The Code map page in the Mushi Mushi console is a visual, searchable map of your indexed source files, with architectural layers, imports and search by meaning.
- [Feature requests](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/feature-board): The Feature requests board in Mushi Mushi collects requests from support tickets so members can upvote and comment, and owners or admins can mark them shipped.
- [Help & support](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/feedback): The Help & support page in Mushi Mushi lists the support tickets you filed from the console, active, shipped and all, with unread replies in one place.
- [Fine-tuning](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/fine-tuning): Fine-tuning jobs in Mushi Mushi export classified reports, train a small OpenAI or Bedrock model, validate it, and swap it in for the fast filter or diagnosis.
- [Fixes](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/fixes): The Fixes page tracks every draft pull request Mushi Mushi opened from a bug report, from the moment a fix run starts until the PR is ready or the run fails.
- [Full-stack audit](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/fullstack-audit): The Full-stack audit in Mushi Mushi runs one health check across RLS gaps, recent backend errors and API contract drift, and returns a readable scorecard.
- [Bug clusters (knowledge graph)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/graph): The Bug clusters page in Mushi Mushi graphs your bug groups, components, pages and fixes, so you see which bugs share a cause and what one fix might touch.
- [Mushi health](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/health): The Mushi health page shows whether Mushi Mushi itself works (AI calls, background jobs, provider connections), so you catch a degraded integration early.
- [To-do](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/inbox): The To-do page gathers everything in Mushi Mushi that needs a human decision, like urgent reports, failed fixes, queue failures and health alerts, in one list.
- [Integrations](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/integrations): Set up Mushi Mushi integrations on one page. Open fix pull requests on GitHub, send bugs to Linear, Jira or GitHub Issues, alert Slack and import Sentry errors.
- [Weekly insights](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/intelligence): Weekly insights is the Mushi Mushi plain-English bug digest per app, with bug trends, fix velocity and what to check next, in the console and optionally Slack.
- [User stories · Inventory](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/inventory): The User stories page in the Mushi Mushi console manages inventory.yaml, the pages, actions and stories your app should have, and shows which the gates cover.
- [Improvement runs](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/iterate): The Improvement runs page in Mushi Mushi queues runs where one AI critiques a live URL against your goal and a second scores it, iteration by iteration.
- [Triage grading](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/judge): The Triage grading page in the Mushi Mushi console shows how often a second AI agrees with each diagnosis, week by week, and the worst recent disagreements.
- [Lessons](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/lessons): The Lessons page in the Mushi Mushi console turns a bug that keeps coming back into a coding rule your editor agent can read before its next fix.
- [Plugins](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/marketplace): The Plugins page in the Mushi Mushi console installs outbound plugins, such as a Zapier bridge or your own signed webhook, that receive events for your project.
- [Editor agents (MCP)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/mcp): The Editor agents page connects Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf and other MCP clients to Mushi Mushi and lists the tools your agent can call from the editor.
- [MCP OAuth consent](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/mcp-auth): The consent page the hosted Mushi Mushi MCP server opens when your editor signs in over OAuth, what you approve, and how the authorization flow works.
- [Reporter updates](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/notifications): The Reporter updates page in Mushi Mushi lists widget messages your reporters see, so you can check they hear back when a bug is diagnosed, fixed and shipped.
- [Onboarding](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/onboarding): Get your first bug report into Mushi Mushi with the console's Set up page, from naming your project to a report with a plain-English diagnosis.
- [Overview (Home view)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/overview): The Overview view on Home in the Mushi Mushi console shows seven-day activity and open bugs for every connected app in a team at a glance.
- [Pipeline](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/pipeline): The Pipeline page in the Mushi Mushi console shows every bug from report to deploy, where it is stuck and why, with one-click fixes.
- [Apps (all apps)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/portfolio): The Apps page in Mushi Mushi shows every app in a team, with each app's worst recipe state, hole checks and SDK version, plus fixes that apply across apps.
- [Manage apps](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/projects): Create a Mushi Mushi project, mint an API key, copy the install snippet for your framework and send a test report, all from the Manage apps page.
- [AI prompts](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/prompt-lab): The AI prompts page in the Mushi Mushi console lets you edit and A/B compare the prompts behind each AI step before you promote a new version.
- [Scheduled tests](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/qa-coverage): Scheduled tests in the Mushi Mushi console turn plain-English user flows into browser tests on a schedule, so you find out when login or checkout breaks.
- [SQL query](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/query): Ask about your bug data in Mushi Mushi in plain English or in read-only SQL; the SQL query page shows the SQL it ran, the result rows and a short summary.
- [Processing jobs](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/queue): The Processing jobs page in the Mushi Mushi console shows reports waiting to be diagnosed, retries and dead-letter jobs, and lets you retry failed ones.
- [Real-time collaboration](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/realtime): How Mushi Mushi report pages update live, showing who else has the report open and new triage notes as teammates or the reporter post them.
- [App blueprint](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/recipe): The App blueprint page in the Mushi Mushi console shows what this app is built from, the state of each part, and the draft pull request a change opens.
- [Releases](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/releases): The Releases page in the Mushi Mushi console drafts a changelog for each version from the bug reports marked fixed, crediting the users who reported them.
- [Pull requests](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/repo): The Pull requests page in the Mushi Mushi console lists open pull requests in connected GitHub repos, with fix branches, CI status and what each fix agent did.
- [Bugs](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/reports): The Bugs page is the Mushi Mushi bug list. Filter by status, severity, category and component, and start with the recommended action at the top.
- [Research](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/research): The Research page in the Mushi Mushi console runs a web search through your Firecrawl key and lets you attach useful results to a bug.
- [Tester rewards](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/rewards): Set up Mushi Mushi tester rewards from the console, with points for reporter activity, a tier ladder, and the perks your app grants at each tier.
- [SDK health](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/sdk-health): SDK health in Mushi Mushi lists what stops your app's reports arriving, like a missing install, missing CI keys, an outdated SDK or a blocking CSP, with fixes.
- [SDK upgrade lockfile helper](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/sdk-upgrade-lockfile): Add one workflow to your repo so Mushi Mushi's SDK upgrade PRs arrive with a refreshed lockfile and pass npm ci or pnpm install --frozen-lockfile.
- [Settings](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/settings): The Settings page in Mushi Mushi holds every project option, from bug alerts and spend limits to your own AI keys, web tools, voice reports and SDK connection.
- [Setup Copilot](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/setup-copilot): Setup Copilot, now Set up > Fix a problem in Mushi Mushi, checks a project's SDK heartbeat, version and fix dispatch, with copy-paste CLI commands per step.
- [Agent skills](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/skill-pipelines): Agent skills in Mushi Mushi recommend skills from the kenji skills and skills.sh ecosystem for each classified bug and run them as pipelines during review.
- [Single sign-on](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/sso): Register a SAML 2.0 identity provider for Mushi Mushi in Supabase Auth, and record OIDC provider details, from the Single sign-on view of the console.
- [Storage](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/storage): The Storage view in the Mushi Mushi console chooses where report screenshots and attachments are kept, managed storage or your own bucket, per project.
- [Team](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/team): The Team page in the Mushi Mushi console brings members, billing, AI spend, audit log, single sign-on, compliance and storage together as views of one page.
- [Teams and members](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/teams): How teams work in Mushi Mushi. Organizations own projects, billing, invitations and the member roster, and project access comes from membership.
- [All users](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/users): All users is an operator-only directory of every Mushi Mushi account with plan, MRR and churn; other visitors see a not-found page instead.
- [UX runs](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/ux-runs): The UX runs page in Mushi Mushi shows each screen your agent worked on in a mushi ux run, with its plan, attempts, before/after screenshots, and what was kept.
- [Verified merge](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/verified-merge): Mushi Mushi merges a cloud agent's fix on its own only with proof, a test that fails without the fix and passes with it, run in your own CI.
- [Voice reports](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/admin/voice): Report a bug by voice from the Mushi Mushi console. Say what is wrong, confirm the transcript, and a draft pull request is started for you.
- [Blog](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/blog): Notes from building Mushi Mushi — the real numbers behind the funnel, open-source licensing, launches, and how AI-built apps get debugged in practice.
- [Mushi Mushi goes AGPLv3: the honest open source story](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/blog/agplv3-relicense): Why Mushi Mushi relicensed its server to AGPLv3 while keeping every SDK MIT — the open-core reasoning, what changes for self-hosters, and what stays free.
- [From "this is broken" to a draft PR: building Mushi Mushi](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/blog/auto-fix-loop): How Mushi Mushi turns a one-sentence user complaint into a classified, deduped, AI-judged draft PR, and why the human stays in the loop the whole way.
- [Launch Week 1 — five features, five days](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/blog/launch-week-1): The five features Mushi Mushi shipped in June 2026, one a day, from MCP install to CLI browser sign-in. The public launch posts it promised did not go out.
- [I shipped a bug tool for 5 months and got 9 signups. Here's what the data said.](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/blog/nine-signups-what-the-data-said): Five months after launch, Mushi Mushi had 30 npm packages, an MCP server in every registry and nine signups. What the data said, and what changed.
- [Changelog](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/changelog): What shipped in Mushi Mushi — new SDK releases, console features, MCP tools, and fixes, in plain English with dates.
- [Mushi Mushi Cloud](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/cloud): Hosted Mushi Mushi. Bug reports, plain-English diagnoses, and fix dispatch without running servers. Free for one app with 100 diagnoses a month.
- [Compare](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/compare): Honest, dated comparisons of Mushi Mushi with Sentry, Jam and PostHog, plus Sentry alternatives for solo founders. Every number links to its source.
- [Jam vs Mushi Mushi](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/compare/jam-vs-mushi): Jam.dev vs Mushi Mushi in 2026. A teammate recording a bug in the Jam extension versus a user reporting from your app, MCP handoff and free tiers.
- [PostHog session replay vs Mushi Mushi](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/compare/posthog-session-replay-vs-mushi): PostHog session replay vs Mushi Mushi in 2026. Every session recorded versus the one a user flagged as broken, free tiers, and why teams run both.
- [Sentry alternatives for solo founders](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/compare/sentry-alternatives-for-solo-founders): Sentry alternatives for solo founders in 2026. Bugsnag, Rollbar, highlight.io, PostHog and Mushi Mushi compared on free tiers, self-hosting and AI fixes.
- [Sentry vs Mushi Mushi](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/compare/sentry-vs-mushi): Sentry vs Mushi Mushi in 2026. What each captures, Sentry's free tier and Seer pricing next to Mushi's free plan (1 app, 100 diagnoses), and running both.
- [Concepts](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts): Mushi Mushi's core ideas in one place. Capture, plain-English diagnosis, dedupe into one row, optional agent fixes, verification, and lessons it remembers.
- [Agent contract](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/agent-contract): What Mushi Mushi expects an agent to read before opening a PR, and what it promises in return.
- [Agent PR review](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/agent-pr-review): In Mushi Mushi, Claude Opus 5.5 reviews every fix pull request a coding agent opens, and a "hold" stops Mushi from merging it until you choose to.
- [Anti-gaming & reputation](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/anti-gaming): How Mushi Mushi keeps bug reports honest. Reporter reputation against spam and point farming, and prompt-fatigue limits so real users are not nagged.
- [App recipe and design system](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/app-recipe): The Mushi Mushi App Recipe records what your app is made of, so a diagnosis can say what changed and a fix can respect your design system.
- [Architecture](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/architecture): How Mushi Mushi is built. A Hono gateway in front of Supabase, the edge functions behind it, and the relational, vector and graph stores that hold each report.
- [Mushi Bounties: crowd-testing marketplace](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/bounty-marketplace): Mushi Bounties is the Mushi Mushi crowd-testing marketplace. Publish your app, and real testers file bug reports and earn points they can redeem for rewards.
- [How Mushi Mushi reads a bug report](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/classification): How Mushi Mushi turns a raw bug report and screenshot into a plain-English diagnosis. The fast filter, the diagnosis and vision steps, and what gets stored.
- [Closed-loop evolution: the thesis](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/closed-loop): The thesis behind Mushi Mushi. Why AI-built apps need a closed loop from what users feel to a verified fix, and how capture, diagnosis and fixes connect.
- [Project ID & API keys](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/credentials): Where to find your Mushi Mushi project ID and API key, what the report:write and mcp scopes allow, the one mushi_ key format, and env var names per framework.
- [API error catalog](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/error-catalog): Stable error codes returned by the Mushi Mushi API envelope, how to read them in the console, and how they correlate with Sentry and Langfuse.
- [The evolution loop: how Mushi Mushi closes the cycle](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/evolution-loop): The five Mushi Mushi stages that turn a user-felt bug into a merged fix and a lesson rule, without Jira, QA teams or PM bottlenecks.
- [Fix drafts & PRs](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/fix-orchestrator): Fix dispatch in Mushi Mushi. A coding agent drafts the change, a draft pull request opens with a rationale, and an Opus review decides if it is ready for CI.
- [Inventory and gates (v2)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/inventory-and-gates): The Mushi Mushi inventory.yaml lists every page, story and action in your app, and five composite gates fail the build when a change breaks that contract.
- [Judge & self-improvement](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/judge-loop): How Mushi Mushi checks and tunes its classifier. A nightly judge scores diagnoses, candidate prompts are A/B tested, and a week-over-week drop raises an alert.
- [Knowledge graph](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/knowledge-graph): How Mushi Mushi links reports, components, fixes and developers in a per-project knowledge graph, with pgvector for similarity and Apache AGE for traversal.
- [Known holes in dependencies](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/known-holes): Mushi Mushi checks the exact versions in your lockfiles and runtime pins against published advisories, and files each fixable hole as a bug with the upgrade.
- [Multi-repo coordinated fixes](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/multi-repo-fixes): When one bug spans a frontend and a backend repo, Mushi Mushi plans the fix across both and opens one cross-linked pull request per repository.
- [Open source & licensing](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/open-source): What's open in Mushi Mushi: MIT SDKs to embed anywhere, an AGPLv3 server and console to self-host, a commercial edition, and what the hosted service keeps.
- [Connecting your orchestrator (MCP / A2A / REST / AG-UI)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/orchestrator-interop): Connect any agent orchestrator to Mushi Mushi. MCP, A2A, REST and AG-UI surfaces for Cursor, Claude, OpenAI Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI and your own agents.
- [Rewards & contributor identity](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/rewards): How the Mushi Mushi rewards program works. Reporters earn points for reports and triage, climb project-defined tiers, and get perks from your app via webhooks.
- [Runtime config](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/runtime-config): How the Mushi Mushi SDK fetches widget and capture settings from the console at startup, how they merge with your init options, and when to turn it off.
- [One login and one purchase across your apps](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/shared-login): How to let people sign in once and keep what they bought across several of your apps, and what Mushi Mushi checks so it keeps working.
- [Where the report button lives](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/concepts/trigger-modes): Choose where the Mushi Mushi bug-report button lives: corner stamp, edge tab, banner, your own button via attach, or fully manual, on web and mobile.
- [Sample diagnosis: Pay now does nothing on a phone](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/demo/diagnosis): A sample Mushi Mushi diagnosis you can read without signing up. A user's complaint, what the widget captured, the plain-English cause and the fix prompt.
- [Cursor integration](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/integrations/cursor): Wire Mushi Mushi into Cursor with one command. Get fix context, lessons and fix dispatch right from the editor.
- [Voice intake](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/integrations/voice-intake): Say a bug on your phone and Mushi Mushi files it, or opens a draft PR after you confirm. Works from an iOS Shortcut, Telegram, Slack or the console.
- [Launch Week](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/launch-week): How Mushi Mushi launches now. One public post per release (Show HN, then Product Hunt), the gate each release must pass, and what we publish after.
- [Legal](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/legal): Privacy policy and terms of service for Mushi Mushi Cloud, the SDKs, and the tester program.
- [Privacy Policy](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/legal/privacy): What Mushi Mushi collects, why, who processes it, how long it is kept, and how to exercise your rights under GDPR and Japan's APPI.
- [Terms of Service](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/legal/terms): The terms for Mushi Mushi Cloud, the admin console, the SDKs and the Bounties tester marketplace. Plans, limits, AI-output disclaimer, licenses and liability.
- [Migration guides](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations): Step-by-step guides for moving an app onto Mushi Mushi from Sentry, Instabug, Shake, LogRocket, BugHerd or Pendo, or between React, Vue and mobile runtimes.
- [BugHerd → Mushi Mushi](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/bugherd-to-mushi): Move from BugHerd to Mushi Mushi. Map pin-to-element feedback to Mushi's element picker, screenshot markup and metadata capture, with an interactive checklist.
- [Migration: Capacitor → React Native](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/capacitor-to-react-native): Port an Ionic or Capacitor app to React Native. A full plan with a Mushi Mushi API map and CI/CD recipes for Expo EAS or React Native CLI with Fastlane.
- [Cordova → Capacitor](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/cordova-to-capacitor): Migrate a Cordova app to Capacitor in place (same web code, a new native shell) and add Mushi Mushi bug reporting with @mushi-mushi/capacitor.
- [Cordova → React Native](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/cordova-to-react-native): Move a Cordova app to React Native in two hops (stabilise on Capacitor first, then port screen by screen) without losing Mushi Mushi bug reporting.
- [Create React App → Vite](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/cra-to-vite): Migrate a Create React App project to Vite. Run the codemod, rename REACT_APP_ env vars to VITE_, and keep your Mushi Mushi React setup working.
- [Instabug (Luciq) → Mushi Mushi](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/instabug-to-mushi): Replace Instabug (now Luciq) with Mushi Mushi for in-app bug reporting in React Native. Config mapping, shake-to-report, a beta validation pass and a checklist.
- [LogRocket Feedback → Mushi Mushi](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/logrocket-feedback-to-mushi): Collect bug reports with Mushi Mushi while keeping LogRocket for session replay. Both SDKs run side by side, with a step-by-step checklist.
- [Mushi Mushi SDK upgrades (0.x → 1.x)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/mushi-sdk-upgrade): Upgrade @mushi-mushi packages from 0.x to the current 1.x releases. The real breaking changes by package, the version-bump command, and the current versions.
- [Native iOS / Android → Hybrid](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/native-to-hybrid): Should you wrap a native iOS or Android app in Capacitor or React Native? When it pays off, how to do it, and where the Mushi Mushi SDKs fit either way.
- [Next.js Pages → App Router](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/nextjs-pages-to-app-router): Move a Next.js app from the Pages Router to the App Router step by step. Where to mount Mushi Mushi, CSP for static export, and client component boundaries.
- [Pendo Feedback → Mushi Mushi](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/pendo-feedback-to-mushi): Pendo retired classic Feedback on 2026-08-01. Move in-app feedback and bug reports to Mushi Mushi while keeping Pendo for analytics and guides.
- [React Native CLI ↔ Expo](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/react-native-cli-to-expo): Move between React Native CLI and Expo either way (EAS Build and OTA updates, or expo prebuild for full native control) with Mushi Mushi bug reporting intact.
- [Sentry + Mushi Mushi (enrich or standalone)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/sentry-to-mushi): Add Mushi Mushi alongside Sentry or run it on its own. Three setups, the Sentry webhook for errors, and user bug reports with plain-English diagnoses.
- [Shake → Mushi Mushi](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/shake-to-mushi): Replace the Shake bug-reporting SDK with Mushi Mushi and keep shake-to-report on mobile. Config mapping, identity, and a cut-over checklist.

- [Vue 2 → Vue 3](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/migrations/vue-2-to-vue-3): Upgrade a Vue 2 app to Vue 3 and move from the plain Mushi Mushi web SDK to the @mushi-mushi/vue plugin, with an interactive migration checklist.

- [CI runners](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/operating/ci-runners): See where your tests run and why a Mushi Mushi fix waits. Tell a broken fix from a stopped test machine, and add your own machine as a runner safely.
- [Deployment & releases](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/operating/deployment): How Mushi Mushi's maintainers ship the SDKs, edge functions, console and docs. A public summary of the release process; app developers never need to run it.
- [Status & Uptime](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/operating/status): Mushi Mushi Cloud status. The live status page for the API, hosted MCP, console and docs, what it checks, and what is and is not promised about uptime.
- [Plugin marketplace](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins): Send Mushi Mushi events to the tools you already use as HMAC-signed Standard Webhooks, with 13 first-party plugin packages and an SDK to build your own.
- [Bugsnag](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/bugsnag): Copy triaged Mushi Mushi bug reports into Bugsnag and mark the error fixed when the fix merges. A self-hosted plugin with a Data API token.
- [Building a plugin](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/building): Build your own Mushi Mushi plugin, an HTTP endpoint that receives HMAC-signed webhook events and checks them with @mushi-mushi/plugin-sdk in a few lines.
- [Crashlytics](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/crashlytics): Flag fixed Mushi Mushi reports in Firebase Remote Config so your mobile app can hide stale crash notices. A self-hosted plugin with a Google access token.
- [Cursor Cloud Agent](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/cursor-cloud): Start a Cursor Cloud Agent automatically when a Mushi Mushi report qualifies. It investigates, drafts a fix and opens a draft PR that names the report.
- [Discord](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/discord): Post Mushi Mushi report and fix events to a Discord channel. Paste a channel webhook on the Integrations page, or run the self-hosted Discord plugin.
- [Webhook events](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/events): Reference for the webhook events Mushi Mushi plugins receive. The shared envelope, each event's payload, and how to subscribe to only the events you need.
- [GitHub Issues](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/github-issues): Open a GitHub issue for every triaged Mushi Mushi report and close it when the fix lands. Set it up on the Integrations page, or self-host the plugin.
- [Jira Cloud](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/jira): Open Jira Cloud issues from Mushi Mushi bug reports and keep their status in step. Set it up on the Integrations page, or self-host the Jira plugin.
- [Linear](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/linear): File Linear issues from Mushi Mushi bug reports. Connect Linear on the Integrations page, or run the self-hosted Linear plugin with an API key and team id.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/msteams): Send cards to a Microsoft Teams channel when Mushi Mushi triages a report or a fix lands. Paste a Workflows webhook in Integrations, or self-host the plugin.
- [PagerDuty](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/pagerduty): Page your on-call rotation via PagerDuty when Mushi Mushi triages a bug as critical, and resolve it when the fix lands. Setup with an Events API v2 routing key.
- [Rollbar](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/rollbar): Copy triaged Mushi Mushi bug reports into Rollbar items and try to resolve them when fixes ship. A self-hosted plugin with an access token and project id.
- [Sentry](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/sentry): Two-way Sentry integration. Sentry errors land in the Mushi Mushi queue, merging a fix resolves the issue, and an optional plugin copies triaged reports back.
- [Slack app](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/slack): Triage Mushi Mushi bug reports from Slack. Add the app from the Integrations page, and each report posts as a card with buttons to fix, resolve or dismiss.
- [Zapier](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/plugins/zapier): Send every Mushi Mushi event to Zapier and on to thousands of apps such as Notion, Google Sheets and HubSpot. Catch Hook setup and event filters.

- [SDK presets](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/presets): Mushi Mushi SDK presets such as production-calm set widget, capture and proactive-prompt defaults in one line, and any explicit Mushi.init option still wins.
- [React & Next.js bug reporting SDK](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/react): Reference for @mushi-mushi/react, Mushi Mushi for React. MushiProvider, useMushi, useMushiSdk and useMushiReport hooks, user identity, rewards hooks and badge.
- [@mushi-mushi/react-native](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/react-native): Reference for @mushi-mushi/react-native, Mushi Mushi for React Native and Expo. MushiProvider, hooks, shake-to-report, screenshots, identity and offline queue.
- [Sentry Replay coexistence](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/sentry-replay-coexistence): Run Mushi Mushi next to Sentry Session Replay. Initialise Sentry first so Mushi attaches the Sentry event and replay IDs to every bug report it sends.

- [@mushi-mushi/ux](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/ux): @mushi-mushi/ux, the Mushi Mushi UX tool, runs your coding agent over each screen, measures every change and keeps only what helps, on a branch you review.
- [@mushi-mushi/vue](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/vue): Mushi Mushi for Vue 3, @mushi-mushi/vue. MushiPlugin, the useMushi, useMushiReport and useMushiWidget composables, user identity and submitting reports.
- [@mushi-mushi/wasm-classifier](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/wasm-classifier): @mushi-mushi/wasm-classifier filters junk bug reports in the browser, before they reach the server or your LLM.
- [JavaScript bug reporting SDK for the browser](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/sdks/web): Reference for @mushi-mushi/web, the Mushi Mushi browser SDK. Screenshots, console and network capture, the Shadow DOM widget, sampling, beforeSend and privacy.
- [Security & compliance](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/security): How Mushi Mushi protects bug reports. Where data is stored, your own keys and storage, retention sweeps, RLS checks, prompt-injection defence, SOC 2 readiness.
- [BYO storage](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/security/byo-storage): Keep Mushi Mushi screenshots and crash dumps in your own storage bucket instead of Mushi's, with credentials in Vault and signed URLs.
- [Bring-your-own-key](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/security/byok): Use your own Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter key for a Mushi Mushi project, so diagnosis, fix and grading runs bill to your provider account.
- [Data residency](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/security/data-residency): Where Mushi Mushi Cloud stores data today (Tokyo, ap-northeast-1), how the region picked at project creation works, and what the SDK does about regions.
- [No client data leakage: what we promise and how we enforce it](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/security/no-leakage-claim): Explicit enumeration of Mushi Mushi's privacy boundaries, the gaps we've closed, and the controls that keep client data isolated.
- [Prompt-injection defence](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/security/prompt-injection): How Mushi Mushi defends its LLM pipeline against prompt injection hidden in bug reports, screenshots and PR text, and the regression corpus that runs in CI.
- [SOC 2 readiness](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/security/soc2): Mushi Mushi's SOC 2 readiness, not certification. Nightly evidence for access, retention, DSAR and availability controls, retention per project, DSAR tracking.
- [Self-hosting](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/self-hosting): Run the whole Mushi Mushi stack yourself with Docker Compose. Your own keys, AGPLv3 server, MIT SDKs, no usage limits.
- [Admin SPA deploy](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/self-hosting/admin-spa): Build and deploy the Mushi Mushi admin console yourself. A static Vite and React app that talks to your Supabase project, and the env vars it needs.
- [Self-host in minutes (Docker Compose)](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/self-hosting/docker-compose): Self-host the whole Mushi Mushi stack with one Docker Compose file. Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions, the admin console and a Caddy reverse proxy.
- [Edge Functions deploy](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/self-hosting/edge-functions): Deploy the Mushi Mushi Supabase Edge Functions for a self-hosted install. The minimal ingest and classification set, the full list, and the secrets they need.
- [Langfuse + Sentry](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/self-hosting/observability): Wire Langfuse LLM tracing and Sentry error tracking into a self-hosted Mushi Mushi server. The Edge Function secrets and what each trace records.
- [Supabase setup](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/self-hosting/supabase): Set up a Supabase project for self-hosted Mushi Mushi. Link the CLI, push every migration, and check the Postgres extensions the server needs.
- [Use cases & comparisons](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/use-cases): Where Mushi Mushi fits. An open-source Sentry alternative, a debugger for Cursor and Claude Code apps, and an MCP bug-fixing server for your editor.
- [AI code bug fixing: report to merged fix](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/use-cases/ai-code-bug-fixing): AI code bug fixing end to end with Mushi Mushi. User reports become plain-English diagnoses, fix prompts and optional draft PRs, with lessons that stop repeats.
- [Debug apps built with Claude Code](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/use-cases/debug-claude-code-apps): How to debug an app Claude Code built. With Mushi Mushi, reports arrive as plain-English diagnoses Claude Code reads and fixes over MCP, fix prompt included.
- [Debug apps built with Cursor](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/use-cases/debug-cursor-apps): How to debug an app Cursor wrote for you. With Mushi Mushi, user bug reports become plain-English diagnoses and fix prompts your Cursor agent applies over MCP.
- [Your Lovable app broke in production](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/use-cases/lovable-app-broke-in-production): What to do when a Lovable, Bolt, Cursor or Claude Code app breaks for a real user. Reproduce it, read the first error, and ask the agent for the smallest fix.
- [MCP server for bug fixing](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/use-cases/mcp-bug-fixing-server): What an MCP bug-fixing server is and how the Mushi Mushi one works. Cursor, Claude Code or Codex read live bug reports, pull fix context, and dispatch fixes.
- [Sentry alternative for AI-built apps](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/use-cases/sentry-alternative): Mushi Mushi, an open-source Sentry alternative for AI-built apps. Plain-English diagnoses and ready fixes, not raw stack traces. Works with or without Sentry.
- [What else Mushi Mushi does](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/what-it-does): Bugs nobody reports: a first-time user test, live-site watch, site audit, security holes, a second AI on every fix, your CI bill, playbooks in rounds.
- [Who Mushi Mushi is for](https://kensaur.us/mushi-mushi/docs/who-its-for): Solo builders who make apps with AI, developers who own their code, and teams: the pains each has and what Mushi Mushi does about them.
